about.title: About Me
about.description:
After seven years as a nursing assistant, then seven years as an after-sales support agent, I chose to make software development my profession. Both jobs taught me to listen, to be patient and to care about the people I help: understanding what someone really needs before looking for a solution.

Trained at the Wild Code School, where I earned my web developer certification, I am now a junior developer at CGI, on a work-study contract alongside the MAALSI Master's degree at CESI Arras until 2028. Day to day, I work with Java, Velocity and Angular: feature and bug-fix tickets, testing, and teamwork.

In the long run, I would like to pass on what I learn by teaching software development.
